jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Hung Yen)
jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager (TPM)

About Molex

At Molex, we create connections for life. Through innovation, engineering excellence, commitment to quality and reliability, and superior customer experience, we improve communication, elevate experiences, and inspire people around the world.

Molex’s Copper Solutions Business Unit (CSBU)
is a global team delivering advanced solutions to worldwide telecommunication and data center customers. CSBU is one of the most technically advanced business units within Molex, designing cutting‑edge, high‑speed, high‑density products that maximize performance, signal integrity, and efficiency.

Position Summary

The Technical Project Manager (TPM)
leads global, cross‑functional teams through the New Product Development (NPD)
process, from project approval through production transfer.

This role partners closely with customers and internal stakeholders, drives project‑level decision‑making, mentors team members, and ensures successful execution across cost, quality, and schedule. The TPM thrives in a fast‑paced, highly technical, global environment and plays a key role in driving Molex and our customers forward.

Key Responsibilities

Partner closely with Product Managers to ensure Molex technology projects fully support customer finished‑goods deliverables.
Lead multiple NPD projects simultaneously, including both customer‑specific and general market programs.
Develop clear internal and external Project Charters defining strategy, scope, financials, and schedules.
Own project communication and reporting to both management and customers.
Manage project change control, decision documentation, and governance processes.
Lead project planning, execution, and closure, including transfer to production ownership.
Develop and manage macro project schedules; hold functional teams accountable for supporting micro schedules.
Mentor and guide team members on project management principles, PDP processes, risk management, issue resolution, and decision‑making.
Proactively identify, document, and execute risk mitigation actions related to cost, quality, and schedule.
Work closely with suppliers to ensure alignment with Molex expectations on timing, cost, and quality.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or related field
Minimum 4 years of project management experience
Proven experience leading product development or NPD projects
Experience in customer‑facing or external executive‑facing roles
Experience leading multi‑national teams in a matrix organization
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (up to 15%)
Ability to work flexibly to accommodate global meetings
Strong preference for candidates fluent in both English & Chinese (Mandarin)

Key Skills & Behaviors

Natural leader with strong sense of ownership and accountability
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder‑management skills
Self‑driven, proactive, and comfortable working in global or remote environments
Contribution‑minded with a strong “can‑do” attitude
Strong organizational, interpersonal, and decision‑making skills

What Will Put You Ahead

PMP certification
MBA or equivalent advanced degree
Bilingual capability in Mandarin, Chinese, or Spanish
Experience working with SAP

Why Join Molex

Molex is committed to building an inclusive, diverse workplace where employees are empowered to create value, grow professionally, and contribute to their communities. We believe in the transformative power of connection — between people, technology, and ideas.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

jobs.description:
About The Role

The role drives complex technical programs from inception to delivery, aligning engineering, product, and infrastructure teams around shared milestones.

The program manager removes cross-functional blockers, standardizes agile delivery processes, and ensures that strategic engineering initiatives are shipped on time and to specification.

Key Responsibilities

Drive end-to-end execution of large-scale technical programs across distributed engineering and product teams
Establish program schedules, define milestones, track dependencies, and manage risk matrices using Jira and Confluence
Facilitate agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and cross-functional syncs to maintain high velocity and alignment
Partner with engineering leadership to allocate resources, manage capacity, and balance technical debt against feature delivery
Track and report programmatic KPIs and OKRs to stakeholders, translating complex technical blockers into actionable business insights
Iterate on delivery frameworks and standard operating procedures to continuously improve team efficiency

What We Are Looking For

4-7 years of technical program or project management experience within a high-growth technology or software engineering environment
Deep familiarity with agile methodologies, software development lifecycles (SDLC), and modern CI/CD deployment pipelines
Advanced proficiency with project management tooling such as Jira, Confluence, Linear, and Notion
Exceptional stakeholder management and technical communication skills across engineering and executive leadership
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field
Bonus: PMP, Scrum Master (CSM/PSM), or SAFe certifications; hands-on background in software development or systems architecture

jobs.title: HR Project Manager, Operational Excellence
jobs.description:
The Impact You'll Make

Step into a key role shaping how we deliver HR services to the 20,000 employees across the EMEA region.

We are looking for a passionate HR professional to join our HR Services organisation. As our new HR Project
Manager
, you’ll help drive improvements in the way we work, streamline processes, and support the ongoing digitalization of our HR services to create efficiencies and a smooth user experience.

You are a hands-on profile with a solid operational understanding and enjoy working with colleagues across HR, IT, and the business to meet our strategic goals.

So, if you have a talent for identifying opportunities for improvement and a passion for driving excellence, this role is for you!

 You will be reporting to the Head of our EMEA Service Center and become part of a team of talented and dedicated HR Professionals located across EMEA.

You are based in Hungary, Poland, Slovenia, or Slovakia. You can either work remotely or from one of our offices: Budapest
(Hungary), Grodzisk Mazowiecki
(Poland), Ljubljana
(Slovenia) or Povazska Bystrica
(Slovakia).

What You’ll Be Doing

Drive excellence: deliver on our HR Services EMEA roadmap focusing on strengthening our new operating model, continuous improvement, and user experience. 
Innovate and optimize:  identify opportunities for automation and digitalization and bring the opportunities to life. 
Lead change: support the implementation of global HR processes and initiatives, ensuring smooth transitions and successful adoption. 
Manage projects: plan and drive big and small projects, keep stakeholders close and use your strong facilitation skills to create excitement and progress.
Case management: analyse service quality and productivity trends, conduct root cause analysis and lead initiatives to optimize usage of ServiceNow. 
Communication: create written communication and presentations that speak to the heart of the target group and convey key messages in a simple manner. 

What We're Looking For

Your professional profile:

Background from the shared services environment and a minimum of 5 years’ experience working in HR.
Experience from a similar position and proven experience with HR process streamlining, continuous improvement and digitalization.
Experience with HR request systems (e.g. ServiceNow) is a must. 
Excellent English language skills.

 On The Personal Side

Drive and passion to fill and excel in the role.
Strong collaboration and facilitation skills to build a strong network and a positive work climate around you.  
Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across different cultures and levels of the organization.
An initiative-taking and pragmatic approach, with an eye for detail and quality.
A self-driven profile with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

What You'll Get From Us

You’ll have the autonomy to lead and deliver on a wide variety of projects — from transitions and process implementation to automation and digitalization initiatives — with a high degree of ownership.
We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.
You’ll receive benefits on top of your salary. Detailed information shall be provided during the recruitment process.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.description:
Your difference is the difference

Do you love to develop and share great ideas? Do you believe your insights can drive people forward? Do you appreciate working with others and building on mutual successes? Perfect. We do, too.

As an employee-owned company, we foster a culture where our people can thrive – and by thrive, we mean a place where you can share your ingenuity, express your difference, and grow in your very own way. Whatever your area, no matter your grade, your unique skills and perspective will help drive change from operations to the C-suite, across a wide of range of projects and channels.

Are you ready to build a future that’s uniquely yours? Join our award-winning team and make a difference that defines you.

RVA is looking for an experienced Project Manager
to join their Land Development
team in a full-time position out of their Ottawa
office. In this role, you will be responsible for business development and managing of land development projects within the greater Ottawa area and working with staff throughout the firm to complete project work.

Duties

Your initial primary duties and responsibilities will include:

Lead the growth of the Land Development practice in Eastern Ontario and the Ottawa area through Business Development initiatives and Managing of Land Development Projects
Liaise with existing clients and develop future new clients, support pursuits and proposals, and monitor budgets and schedules.
Manage tasks, team, schedules, budgets, cost control processes and project work procedures.
Support and contribute to Land Development project work undertaken from other RVA office locations.
Identify and manage project issues and risks and, if needed, enhance resolution or actions; collaborate with other offices for project resources.
Project manage and/or technically support the design team and oversee projects / project performance.
Prepare and/or review detail design drawings, calculations, reports, technical specifications, and proposals.
Provide input to the development of engineering budgets and schedules.
Ensure projects meet the professional needs of RVA and Quality standards and participate in interdisciplinary review of project deliverables.
Liaise with client, suppliers, regulatory agencies, utility companies and contractors; represent RVA in professional associations and agencies.
Mentoring and coaching project teams including technical and field staff.
Other duties as assigned and appropriate for this position.

Qualifications

Must be licensed as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng) within the province of Ontario.
12 plus years progressive experience in Land Development engineering with at least 8 years working in a consultancy.
Land Development Project Experience within the Ottawa Area.
Possess a strong ability to develop and maintain positive relationships with staff and clients.
Operates as a self starter, taking initiative to drive pursuits and projects forward, within a collaborative team framework.
Experience or aptitude for meeting timelines and budgets, proposal writing, client development and other skills appropriate to consulting.
Proven capabilities in writing reports and other technical documents.
Familiar with local design and construction standards and requirements for permits and approvals.
Demonstrates superior oral and written English communication skills.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to develop and maintain positive relationships with staff and clients.
Strong ability to work in a collaborative, team environment.

Your better starts here

We don’t settle for less, and neither should you. As it happens, offering great benefits to our people is entirely possible: the numbers work out. Happy teams mean happy clients. It’s just that simple. From recruitment to flexibility, learning to leadership, wellness to inclusion, we give our people the tools they need to outperform in their careers and build lasting connections with our clients, our culture, and each other.

Competitive compensation packages and performance-based bonuses
Health, paramedical, vision, and dental coverage

Top-up plans for new and expecting parents
Firm-paid holidays, summer and winter breaks, and other leaves of absence that cover everything from extra family time, jury duty, or even completing a degree
RVA Group Pension Plan with match
Global Travel Assist Program that provides emergency out-of-country medical protection for you and your eligible family members on personal and business trips
Access to a variety of free services (e.g., employee and family assistance programs, nutrition advice, caregiver support) and employee discounts (e.g., sports and entertainment tickets, major brands, insurance plans)
Flexible and alternative work arrangements around core hours, including telecommuting and work-from-home options

Compensation Range

The compensation range for this position is from $105,000.00 - $155,000.00

Compensation for this role will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business needs.

Diversity, Inclusion, And Accommodations

jobs.title: AI Project Manager / Scrum Master - Senior Associate
jobs.description:
About Us

With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organisations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.

Line Of Service Overview

Internal Firm Services (IFS) brings together the specialist functions that enable PwC Middle East to run, grow and transform—supporting our people, clients and business with the capabilities needed for the future of work. A career in IFS offers diverse opportunities across Human Capital, Finance, Technology & AI, Clients & Markets, Marketing & Communications, Risk & Quality, Partner Development, Office Management, and Transformation & Change. As we continue to embed data, technology and new-age AI into how we work, we are hiring talent who can help our teams become more AI-enabled, digitally confident and ready to create greater value across PwC Middle East.

Business Unit Overview

T he AI Centre of Excellence (AI CoE) is our central engine for AI strategy, product build, and scale. It governs standards and cost and risk controls, runs AI Factory squads to design and ship custom AI solutions and reusable frameworks (LLM and RAG stacks, integrations on Azure), provides technical consultation on architecture, solution design, and best practices, and drives workforce transformation through training and upskilling to accelerate adoption across our lines of service.

Operating within IFS, the CoE partners with Experience Design and adjacent technology teams, follows a codified operating model and RACI for approvals and observability, and supports proposals, demos, and delivery with a focus on distinctive outcomes and trusted leadership.

How You’ll Contribute

As a Project Manager/Scrum Master, you’ll be responsible for coordinating and delivering AI and GenAI initiatives using Agile methodologies. The role combines project management, sprint facilitation, stakeholder engagement, and delivery governance to ensure successful execution of AI products and solutions.

Working closely with Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and business stakeholders, the role ensures delivery commitments are met, risks are proactively managed, and teams operate efficiently within the AI CoE delivery framework.

Agile Delivery & Scrum Facilitation

Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
Support backlog refinement activities and sprint readiness.
Track sprint progress and team commitments.
Identify and remove delivery impediments and blockers.
Promote Agile best practices and continuous improvement within the team.
Help teams improve sprint predictability, quality, and delivery performance.

Project Coordination

Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, and delivery plans.
Coordinate activities across business and technical teams.
Track project progress against agreed timelines and deliverables.
Monitor dependencies, risks, assumptions, and issues.
Escalate delivery concerns appropriately and ensure timely resolution.
Leveraging historical project data to spot bottlenecks, predict delays, and prevent budget overruns before they occur.
Support project governance and status reporting.

Stakeholder Management

Act as a central point of coordination between stakeholders and delivery teams.
Communicate project status, risks, and key decisions to stakeholders.
Ensure alignment between business expectations and delivery commitments.

AI Delivery Support

Support delivery of AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives.
Coordinate activities between Product Managers, Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts.
Ensure project activities align with AI CoE delivery standards and governance requirements.

Reporting & Governance

Prepare weekly project status reports and dashboards.
Maintain project documentation and action logs.
Track RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) registers.

What You’ll Bring

Experience

3-8 years of experience in Project Management, Scrum Master, PMO, or Agile Delivery roles.
Experience delivering technology, AI, data, analytics, or software development projects.
Experience working in Agile environments.
Experience coordinating cross-functional teams.

Education & Certifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field.
PMI-PMP Certified

Technical Skills & Specialized Knowledge

Project Management

Project planning and coordination
Risk and issue management
Stakeholder communication
Status reporting
Dependency management
Documentation and governance

Agile & Scrum

Scrum framework
Kanban principles
Sprint planning and execution
Agile ceremonies facilitation
Team coaching
Continuous improvement

Technical Awareness

Understanding of AI and Generative AI concepts
Software development lifecycle (SDLC)
Cloud and data platform fundamentals
AI product delivery lifecycle

Tools

Jira
Azure DevOps
Asana
Microsoft 365 Suite

Attributes & Soft Skills

Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across multi-located and diverse teams.
Ability to understand and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Curious, proactive, and eager to learn.
Excellent verbal and written communication in English; Arabic is preferred.

What Sets You Apart

Passion for AI, Generative AI, and emerging technologies.
Strong facilitator who can bridge business and technical teams.
Proactive problem-solver who removes blockers and drives delivery.
Excellent communicator with strong stakeholder management skills.
Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative, agile-minded, and focused on continuous improvement.
Motivated by turning innovative ideas into impactful business solutions.

How You’ll Make a Difference

At PwC Midde East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.

Why You’ll Love Working at PwC

At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job - you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference? Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? You can grow exponentially here. Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East.

jobs.description:
Department:
Water/Wastewater
Location:
Sanford, FL
Compensation:
$112,000 - $175,000 / year

Description

CPH
is seeking a talented individual to join our team as a Senior Project Manager
at our Corporate HQ in Sanford, FL
! This role will be focuses water/wastewater/utilities space requiring a strong blended expertise across project/program management, team leadership, and project design/delivery. A high sense of business acumen and knowledge is required to fulfill this role.

The Senior Project Manager
is accountable for the week-to-week execution and management of assigned projects such as scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk; while leading a production team and coordinating subcontractors, permitting, and deliverables. The PM is the first line on communication and accountable point of contact for clients as well as ensuring full project delivery.

What You'll Do:

Primary Responsibilities--
Responsible for overall project production, delivery, and routine client updates including plans, design reports and technical specifications.
Build and maintain the project plan incorporating scope, schedule, and budget.
Responsible for assigned contract/Extra Work Authorization (EWA) scope and fee preparation and negotiation with client.
Create and maintain project schedule and ensure alignment with financial reporting (Estimated Date of Task Completion, Overall Schedule Milestones, Extra Work Authorizations – EWAs, etc.).
Lead a production team through weekly project reviews, task assignments, as well as coaching and mentoring; ensure project coordination; keeps the team productive and efficient.
Manage project responsibilities and coordinate with various teams, including architects, engineers, designers, consultants, and clients, as part of the project design process.
Utilizes team management skills to lead the design group during the conceptual phase of product development following CPH and client’s standards and templates.
Track planned labor budget vs actual labor burn weekly; corrects variances; monitors labor charges to appropriate phases/tasks through daily timesheet review and identifies scope creep and promptly proposes EWA’s and / or ETC’s.
Serves as assigned client’s day-to-day contact; escalates strategic items to Program Manager (pricing, scope, disputes); supports upsell / cross-sell conversations; coordinates with Project Financial Analysts (PFA) and Project Coordinators (PC).
Prepare pre-bills, percentage complete updates, and billing notes; support collections to keep AR current.
Accountable for project QA/QC.
Enforces safety and Delegation of Authority (DOA); maintains project files / records; captures lessons learned.
Periodic travel to perform business development, client meetings and presentations.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Key Performance Indicators/Metrics Expertise--
Adherence to project schedule and client requirements;
Labor Budget and As Sold Direct Labor Multiplier (DLM):
Achieves or beats labor budgets.
Utilization & Team Engagement:
Team is meeting / exceeding productivity targets and maintain low employee turnover.
Goal:
Zero preventable errors and omissions.
Client Satisfaction:
High client retention, good feedback.
WBR Discipline:
Inputs on time, actions closed, active participation.

Objectives and Goals--
Delivers on time, on budget, with zero preventable errors and omissions.
Keeps assigned Accounts Receivable (AR)/ Work In Progress (WIP) current; issue EWAs promptly; protect margin.
Maintain and communicate accurate schedules, budgets, and forecasts weekly.
Provides professional client experience that leads to repeat work and focuses on client/revenue growth.
Develop junior staff and team.

Accountability and Reporting--
Operates within the Delegation of Authority
Accountable for full production team and project performance
Accountable to the Program Manager (PrM)

Expected Outcomes--
Sustained client relationships leading to repeat business and growth opportunities
Predictable delivery with clean financial and documentation.
A high-through, highly engaged production team that delivers quality work on time.
Developing pipeline of future PMs through mentoring and coaching.
Reduced rework and cycle times; increased value capture; higher DLM.

What You'll Need:

Skills and Competencies--
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills to serve as a trusted advisor to clients.
Strong industry and project management knowledge can lead to multi-discipline coordination
Working knowledge of project controls (ETC, labor budgets, cost codes, etc.)
Proficiency with project management and financial tools (e.g., VantagePoint, Smartsheet, Power BI).
Analytical skills to interpret and act on projects and financial data.
Effective negotiation and problem-solving capabilities.
Drives accountability; clear tasking and follow-through; collaborative.
Experience with collaborative and alternative project delivery methods (e.g., Design-Build, CMAR, Progressive Design-Build, or Public-Private Partnerships) is a plus.

Education and Experience--
A Bachelor’s degree in engineering required (Civil or Environmental Engineering preferred).
A Master's degree in the discipline or Business Administration (MBA) is highly preferred.
Active professional licensure (P.E.)
A minimum of 5+ years of progressive professional experience within the A/E/C industry (Water/Wastewater/Utilities preferred).
Valid state-issued driver's license with a clean driving record.

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet The Team

Join us at Dexcom, where we are the innovative force transforming diabetes management. As a member of the Innovation, Ventures & Sensor Technology
(IVST) PMO, you will drive the development of groundbreaking sensor technologies that empower individuals to understand their health in real time.

The Senior
Staff Technical Program Manager, Sensor Technology (STPM)
is a specialized role designed to bridge the Innovation, Ventures & Sensor Technology
(IVST) and other organizations within and beyond R&D. You will specialize in managing the development and advancement of biosensing technology within the context of R&D Product Development and On-market Sustaining programs. You will partner closely with the Sensor Technology System Lead
, who serves as the technical lead, while you provide project management leadership to drive the sensor from concept through the full product lifecycle. You will also partner closely with overall program leads and cross-functional team members for product development, sustaining, and broader system engineering and integration efforts.

Where You Come In

Workstream Leadership: Lead the Sensor Tech workstream, ensuring the successful design and development of new sensor technologies within broader R&D programs.
Integrated Planning: Own and maintain the integrated program timeline and Work Breakdown Structure for all sensor technology workstreams, ensuring alignment with overall platform schedules.
Design Controls & Compliance: Drive project activities in strict accordance with 21 CFR 820 Design Controls, ensuring all sensor-specific design inputs, outputs, and verifications meet regulatory standards.
Budget & Resource Management: Partner with the program leadership to plan and update the program budget; navigate priority conflicts and unblock technical resource issues to keep the workstream on track.
Risk Management: Lead Sensor Tech risk management, proactively identifying technical risks and integrating them into the broader Program Risk Management framework.

Build & Test Coordination: Coordinate sensor-level build and test planning, ensuring all program builds utilize the correct sensor configurations and that test methods are developed and validated.
Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary programmatic liaison for the sensor workstream, delivering status updates to internal project teams and external stakeholders.

Medical Device Development Expertise: Significant experience managing medical device development under 21 CFR 820 Design Controls is required. You understand how to maintain agility within a highly regulated framework.
Technical Foundation: Strong preference for formal training and/or significant experience in Material Science and/or Electrochemistry. You can speak the language of the scientists and engineers to effectively manage technical trade-offs.
Ambiguity Management: You are comfortable operating in the dynamic space between early-stage advanced technology development and formal product development.
Project Management Mastery: Extensive experience managing complex projects and/or programs using waterfall and hybrid methodologies.
Communication & Influence: Skilled at conveying complex technical data to non-technical audiences and driving accountability across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Soft Skills: You are resourceful, self-sufficient, and curious, with a positive attitude that inspires confidence in project success even under challenging circumstances.
Cross-functional fluency: You are experienced and adept at navigating and thriving in a matrixed, cross-functional organizational environment.

A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
A full and comprehensive benefits program.

jobs.title: Sr. Principal, AI Delivery Lead, Tech Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Northern Trust

Northern Trust, a Fortune 500 company, is a globally recognized, award-winning financial institution that has been in continuous operation since 1889.

Northern Trust is proud to provide innovative financial services and guidance to the world’s most successful individuals, families, and institutions by remaining true to our enduring principles of service, expertise, and integrity. With more than 130 years of financial experience and over 22,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

Role Description

Northern Trust seeks a Cybersecurity AI Delivery Lead
to drive execution of strategic cybersecurity projects and programs that enable secure adoption and operation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) including agentic AI systems and Large Language Models (LLMs.) The Delivery Lead ensures AI solutions are designed and implemented with appropriate identity controls for both human and non-human/agent identities, robust data protection and privacy controls for prompts and training data, and operational monitoring and response controls for AI-enabled services and workloads.

Major Duties

Program Delivery

Lead global, cross-functional teams consisting of security engineers, platform engineers, data/ML engineers, product owners, and consultants to drive successful execution of strategic cybersecurity and AI security projects and programs.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define expected benefits, risk-reduction outcomes, and measurable control objectives for AI-enabled capabilities; ensure successful achievement through project completion.
Plan and execute delivery of AI-related IAM controls (e.g., workload identities, managed identities/service principals, least privilege, approval workflows, secrets/key management) to govern access by AI services and autonomous agents.
Plan and execute delivery of AI-related data protection controls (e.g., data classification, DLP, encryption/key management, retention, masking/tokenization, prompt/response handling, embedding and vector store protections) aligned to enterprise privacy and regulatory requirements.
Plan and execute delivery of AI-related security operations controls (e.g., logging/telemetry for AI requests, abuse monitoring, anomaly detection, SIEM/SOAR integrations, incident response playbooks, red teaming, and continuous validation).
Identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies to ensure successful project completion. This includes AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, insecure output handling, and model theft.
Develop integrated project schedules including effort estimates and task sequencing; ensure projects are optimally coordinated across product teams, control owners, and platform teams for efficient delivery.
Lead resolution of conflicts and escalations in support of project or program delivery.
Create and submit weekly project/program status reports that are accurate, timely, and comply with team guidelines; provide clear, executive-ready risk and decision narratives.
Establish and maintain a project artifact repository; review deliverables to ensure quality and adherence to internal software delivery methodology as well as AI lifecycle governance.

Communication And Stakeholder Management

Develop project charters; develop and execute project communication plans.
Facilitate engagement with cross-impacted technology and business stakeholders.
Translate complex AI/LLM and agentic-system concepts (architecture, data flows, model behavior, controls) into clear, actionable plans and decisions for stakeholders.
Identify and execute approaches to resolve complex problems through critical thinking, structured analysis, and fact-based recommendations.

Change / Risk Management

Define and document project scope and ensure scope alignment to project objectives and goals.
Perform and follow project change control procedures for scope, resources, and financials where required.
Ensure adherence to technology Change Management requirements and procedures for system implementations and AI model/service releases.
Drive AI security and risk activities across the delivery lifecycle including AI threat modeling, control design reviews, testing/evaluation, and go-live readiness assessments.

Financial Management

Oversee Financial Management And Performance For Projects Including

developing and/or managing project-specific capital and expense budgets including all financial form submissions required by internal finance teams
preparing and submitting timely monthly forecasts (i.e., Clarity PPM)
proactively analyzing and managing monthly budget variance
optimizing spending on assigned projects
participation in annual budget planning

Staff Management

Identify project resource needs and work with leadership to ensure staffing requirements are met.
Manage project resources to deliver tasks, optimize resource utilization, and resolve conflicts.
Provide constructive performance feedback regarding staff performance to leadership and line managers.
Foster a supportive project delivery environment that encourages participation, teamwork, and collaboration.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience Required

A successful candidate for the role will have at least 10 years of overall experience including in the Financial Services industry, with at least 5 years’ experience leading and managing high-visibility technology projects that involve Artificial Intelligence. Additionally, the candidate will possess:

Strong executive presence and communication skills with experience leading high-visibility initiatives in a fast-paced program environment.
Cybersecurity Project Management Experience – leading and driving execution of cybersecurity projects related to Identity & Access Management (e.g., PAM, IGA, IAA), Data Protection, Security Operations, Attack Surface Management, or adjacent control domains.
AI Delivery & Security Experience including delivering AI/ML or GenAI capabilities (including LLM and agentic AI solutions) in regulated environments, with demonstrated expertise in securing AI services, data pipelines, and AI-enabled applications.
Agentic AI & LLM Technical Fluency, including working knowledge of LLM application patterns (e.g., tool/function calling, orchestration, vector/embedding stores), agent frameworks, and common failure modes (hallucinations, prompt injection, excessive agency).
AI-Related IAM Controls – experience designing/implementing identity and access controls for AI services and agents (e.g., workload identities, managed identities/service principals, OAuth/OIDC flows, RBAC/ABAC, privileged access workflows, secrets and API key management, approval, and just-in-time access).
AI-Related Data Protection Controls – experience implementing data governance and protection controls for training/grounding data and user prompts/responses (e.g., classification, DLP, encryption/CMK, tokenization/masking, retention, secure data sharing, access logging, and data residency considerations).
AI Security Operations Controls – experience operationalizing monitoring and response for AI services (e.g., audit and diagnostic logging, telemetry for model endpoints, abuse monitoring, anomaly detection, SOC runbooks, incident response for data leakage or model misuse).
Framework & Threat Modeling Knowledge – familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) and AI threat catalogs (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS) and ability to translate them into delivery requirements, controls, and measurable outcomes.
Organizational Savvy – experience working within a matrixed organization to drive delivery of complex projects involving multiple disciplines.
Critical Thinking Skills – ability to oversee ambiguous or complex issues including identifying creative resolution paths and gaining alignment and support from leadership and stakeholders to bring to resolution.
Superior Communication Skills – ability to translate complex work into digestible terms; able to articulate ideas and information verbally and in writing for varying audiences, including senior executives.

Description

The Opportunity

KWI keeps specialty retail running for Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and dozens of other brands, and behind every storefront is an engineering team shipping constantly. Today those releases are coordinated on instinct and hallway conversations. You're here to change that. As our Technical Program Manager, you'll own the master release timeline, build the system that keeps every team aligned, and make shipping shorter, smoother, and more predictable, reporting straight to the CTO with a clear mandate to fix what slows us down.

The Company

We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a unified commerce solution that is designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and many other globally recognizable brands.

We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, eCommerce, CRM, and Loss Prevention into one cloud-based platform. We are a Values and Mission driven organization, and we believe that if we develop and demonstrate leadership in our strategy, operations, and people, we will continue to drive product innovation and service excellence.

As the Technical Program Manager, you excel at the following core competencies

Cross-team release coordination
Own the master release timeline across all engineering teams, with a particular focus on the POS release cycle.
Map and track cross-team dependencies; surface conflicts early and drive resolution before they become delays. Facilitate go/no-go checkpoints.
You can approve a go based on readiness data; all no-go decisions escalate to the CTO and Head of Product.
Manage the release calendar so teams on different schedules do not collide. Establish and enforce change control: once scope is locked, late changes require formal approval with an impact assessment

Cross-functional coordination
Define and maintain RACI matrices for release activities across Engineering, QA, Technical Writing, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Run release readiness reviews that include all involved departments, not just engineering.
Serve as the single point of accountability for program-level release status visibility across the organization.

Risk management and escalation
Proactively identify risks to timelines, scope, and quality across all teams.
Maintain a risk register and drive mitigation plans.
Escalate to the CTO and Head of Product when cross-team conflicts cannot be resolved at the team level.

The impact you'll make

Process definition and documentation
Convert tribal knowledge into documented, repeatable processes: release runbooks, checklists, onboarding guides.
Define and maintain the release process end-to-end so it is survivable if any individual is unavailable.
Establish templates for cross-team planning: dependency maps, risk registers, status reports.
Identify bottlenecks and gaps; propose and implement improvements using retrospective data.

Reporting and continuous improvement
Design and own the organization-wide status reporting system: template, cadence, format, and a compilation mechanism so the report assembles itself.
Author program-level status reports directly covering cross-team releases, dependency health, risks, and milestones.
Partner with engineering leadership to mature delivery practices and introduce tooling that improves velocity and visibility.
Establish program-level metrics (cycle time, release predictability, dependency-related delays) and use them to drive improvement.

What you will bring

5 to 9 years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a comparable role coordinating across multiple engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to build and run release coordination at the program level, not just within a single team or project.
Strong technical fluency: you can hold a substantive conversation about architecture, dependencies, and technical risk without needing it simplified for you.
Experience defining and documenting processes from scratch, including runbooks, RACI matrices, and dependency tracking frameworks.
Track record of managing cross-functional stakeholders, including product, QA, marketing, and customer success, through complex releases.
Clear written communication: your status reports give leadership the information they need to make decisions, not a list of what everyone is working on.

Bonus points
Experience in a SaaS company serving retail or enterprise clients.
Familiarity with Kanban-based delivery workflows and how to mature them into more disciplined frameworks.
Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted workflows for delivery visibility or reporting.
Background working closely with a CTO or VP Engineering in a fast-moving product organization.

Full Medical, Dental and Vision
Annual bonus eligible
Free gym in the building
Generous PTO policy
Summer Fridays....all year round
Tuition Reimbursement
Discount from building café
401(K) with a 50% company match (up to 6% of employee base salary)
Employee Referral Program
(1) Volunteer day each year

Our work space

We understand that our teams need flexibility, which is why we follow a hybrid schedule. Our in-office days of Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, and employees are allowed to work remotely on Wednesdays and Friday.

We are also a collaborative group and believe that getting together in person allows our team to do their best work. Together we enjoy monthly events, bagels every Thursday, a state-of-the-art coffee machine, a full snack pantry and many more surprise and delight moments throughout the year.

jobs.title: Deployment strategist
jobs.description:
👋🏼 ABOUT US At Diligent, we are on a mission to help fintechs and banks automate and enhance Anti-Financial Crime operations with AI agents
. Leading banks and payment companies use us to automate risk investigations across customer onboarding and ongoing monitoring in Europe, the Middle East, the US and Asia.
Our founders have built fraud and AML risk solutions protecting billions in transactions at some of Europe’s leading fintechs. We’re now using AI to rethink how financial institutions investigate customers, assess risk, and run compliance operations.
We already work with leading fintech unicorns and banks globally, are growing fast, and are looking for ambitious problem-solvers who want to help shape how AI changes financial crime operations.

💼 THE ROLE As a Deployment Strategist
, you’ll sit at the intersection of customers, product, engineering and go-to-market
.

Your job is to help us win new customers and then make those customers successful by turning messy, often vaguely defined problems inside a financial institution into successful deployments of our product.

A customer might tell us:
“Our transaction monitoring team team spends too much time reviewing alerts.”
“We want to automate 60% of these investigations without increasing risk.”
“Our customer fraud rates have spiked over the past 3 months and we want to reduce exposure”

Your role is to get underneath that problem.

You’ll understand the existing workflow, identify where the real bottlenecks are, work with the customer to define what success looks like, collaborate closely with our engineers to configure or extend the product, test it against real cases, diagnose where it fails, and drive the deployment until it creates measurable operational impact.

At the same time, you’ll be responsible for helping us create those opportunities in the first place. You’ll identify and reach out to target financial institutions, build relationships with senior decision-makers, run discovery conversations and demos, and turn initial interest into concrete deployments.

Typically, this looks like: [40%] New business acquisition:
Own outbound prospecting and help build pipeline across banks, PSPs and fintechs. Research target accounts, cold call and run personalized outreach, qualify opportunities, lead discovery conversations, support demos and help move prospects from first conversation into a trial or deployment.
[40%] Deployment strategy + customer success:
Own pilots and implementations from initial problem definition through testing, iteration, rollout and measurable results. Dive deeply into customer workflows, policies, data and operational processes, define success metrics, diagnose what is preventing success, and work closely with customers and engineers to get deployments performing.
[10%] Internal product + company building:
Bring insights from the field back into our product roadmap, help identify recurring customer problems that should become scalable product capabilities, and contribute to the systems and processes we need as we grow.

You’ll work directly with compliance leaders, operations teams, product teams and executives at banks, PSPs and fintech unicorns.

No two days will look exactly the same. One morning you might be cold calling a Head of Financial Crime at a major bank. That afternoon, you could be analyzing why an active deployment is failing on a particular category of sanctions alerts, then sitting with our engineers to figure out what needs to change.

The core skill is going from an initially ambiguous customer problem to a concrete understanding of what matters, what needs to change, and how technology can create measurable impact
.

5 days a week in our office near Blackfriars Bridge in London
, with occasional travel to customers.

WHAT WE EXPECT You’ll have significant autonomy from day one. We’ll expect you to operate as an extension of the founding team rather than someone waiting for a clearly defined task.
Within days Start driving outbound activity and generating new customer conversations.
Join customer calls and understand how financial institutions actually run risk and compliance operations.
Learn our product deeply enough to demonstrate it and investigate why it succeeds or fails on individual customer cases.
Support active deployments and help unblock customers quickly.

Within weeks Own a meaningful part of our outbound pipeline, from target account research and cold outreach through discovery and trial.
Take ownership of a customer deployment from problem definition through successful rollout.
Map complex operational workflows and turn vague customer feedback into structured product requirements.
Work directly with engineers to test solutions against real customer data and iterate quickly.
Present deployment results and recommendations to senior customer stakeholders.

Within months Consistently generate and progress new commercial opportunities.
Run multiple strategic customer deployments independently.
Become a trusted advisor to senior leaders at our customers.
Identify recurring customer problems that should become scalable product capabilities.
Help shape our product roadmap based on what you see in the field.
Expand successful deployments into new workflows, teams and business units.
Help us refine how Diligent sells, deploys and scales its technology globally.

🤓 ABOUT YOU
Experiences we look for We care much more about trajectory and raw ability than a particular background. Examples of profiles that could fit:
1–3 years in a high-intensity environment such as a VC-backed startup, management consulting, investment banking or a highly operational technology company.
Early startup experience where you worked directly with customers and product or engineering teams.
A strong analytical background combined with evidence that you like building and doing
, not just analyzing.
A top university plus unusually impressive extracurricular projects, businesses or side hustles.
Experience with technical products, data, automation or AI is a strong plus.

Characteristics we look for Hungry and driven:
Early-stage startups are intense, this is not a 9to5 job. You want responsibility, fast learning curves and problems where there isn’t already a playbook.
Extremely curious:
You’re not satisfied with the first explanation of a problem. You keep digging until you understand how the workflow actually works, why it breaks, and what would genuinely improve it.
Commercially hungry:
You enjoy creating opportunities from nothing. You are comfortable picking up the phone, getting ignored, trying again, and figuring out how to get the attention of senior people.
Structured problem solver:
You can take an ambiguous objective, break it into hypotheses and workstreams, identify the highest-leverage issues and drive toward a measurable result.
Technically curious:
You’re comfortable getting close to APIs, data, AI systems and product architecture.
High emotional intelligence:
You can move comfortably between an operations analyst, an engineer and a C-level executive, understanding what each person cares about.
A true owner:
If something is stopping a deal or deployment from succeeding, you feel responsible for figuring out why and getting it solved.
Low ego and highly hands-on:
You care more about solving the problem than about whose job something technically is.

⏳ INTERVIEW PROCESS We want the interview process to resemble the actual job as closely as possible.
Initial application (<2 mins):
Send us your LinkedIn or CV.
Founding GTM Lead meet-and-greet (30 mins):
Understand the company, role and what motivates you.
Deployment work trial (60–90 mins):
Work through a real customer problem. Diagnose the workflow, identify what matters and propose how you would approach the deployment.
Team session (in office):
Meet our Cofounder & CEO, engineers and the wider team.
References + offer:
Ideally over dinner.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager, Provider
jobs.description:
Role Mission

As Implementation Manager for Providers at Hippocratic AI, you will own the end-to-end deployment of our voice AI platform for health system and digital health customers—translating signed contracts into go-live programs that improve patient outcomes at scale. You'll sit at the intersection of project management, technical configuration, and health system operations, ensuring each program launches correctly configured and on schedule. This role exists because health systems are ready to deploy breakthrough AI, and they need an expert who understands their clinical workflows, patient data flows, and operational complexity—someone who can make deployments to diverse provider environments repeatable and scalable.

What You Will Accomplish

Own your first major outcome:
By day 90, you will have successfully deployed your first health system use case from contract to go-live—properly configured, on schedule, and with complete documentation handed off to Customer Success. You'll have established strong relationships with your customer's clinical and operational stakeholder teams and validated the core processes that define provider implementation success.

Drive lasting impact:
At 12 months, you will have deployed multiple use cases across different health systems (post-discharge, disease management, care gaps, and beyond), built reusable playbooks and templates that make each successive deployment faster and more scalable, established HAI's standard platform onboarding process for providers, and become the trusted expert that internal teams and customers turn to for implementation guidance—directly proving out our ability to execute with health systems at scale.

The Team

You'll work alongside Customer Success, Clinical, Product, and Engineering teams—all focused on ensuring health system deployments succeed. You'll partner closely with health system clinical teams, operational leadership, technical staff, and EHR/IT departments. This is a role that requires both deep execution and strategic thinking about how to scale provider implementations across diverse healthcare organizations.

What You'll Do

Own use case deployments end-to-end from contract signature to go-live, serving as the primary project lead for provider implementation engagements and driving accountability to timeline and quality
Build and maintain Implementation Charters for each deployment—documenting timeline, configuration decisions, data requirements, go-live checklists, and sign-off criteria that ensure consistency and quality across diverse provider environments
Configure use cases for deployment including dialer setup, agent configuration, population filters, exclusion rules, call cadence, routing logic, and workflow integration—working directly from use case requirements and translating them into platform configuration
Coordinate with health system data and IT teams to define, validate, and onboard patient data files and EHR integrations—managing data requirements, compliance, and technical connectivity to ensure data quality and seamless integration
Project-manage across health system stakeholder teams including clinical operations, patient care management, IT, EHR administration, and departmental leadership—driving accountability and alignment to go-live timeline
Design agents that fit into clinical workflows and drive measurable outcomes across diverse health system use cases (post-discharge follow-up, disease management, care gap identification, preventive care, and beyond)
Define and refine HAI's standard platform onboarding process for providers—architecting the initial integration, base data pipeline, patient data schema, and EHR system connections that make each additional use case an activation rather than a new integration project
Build and maintain the HAI implementation playbook—documenting what works across different provider types and EHR systems, creating reusable templates and checklists, establishing best practices that make every future deployment faster and more reliable than the last
Hand off to Customer Success at go-live with complete deployment documentation, clinical workflow diagrams, and configuration details, ensuring the CS team can own the customer relationship from day one with full clarity on capabilities and commitments

Location Requirement

This is a remote role with significant field presence. You must be willing to travel 25–40% of the time to client sites for deployments, stakeholder meetings, clinical workflow mapping, and go-live support. Periodic travel to our Menlo Park headquarters is expected for team alignment, playbook refinement, and strategic planning.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of implementation, onboarding, or professional services experience working specifically with health systems, health networks, digital health providers, or provider-focused healthcare organizations
Deep fluency in health system and provider operations and workflows—a baseline understanding of how patients and clinical data move through health systems, EHR workflows, and care delivery processes, with ability to get up to speed quickly in detailed operational areas
Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deployments with 60–120 day timelines and proven ability to drive cross-functional teams (clinical, operational, technical) to go-live
Hands-on experience with provider IT environments and vendor onboarding processes including security questionnaires, BAA requirements, EHR integrations, and care management platform connections
Strong project management and process documentation skills with ability to create and maintain playbooks, checklists, clinical workflow diagrams, and reusable templates across different provider types

Preferred Qualifications

Background at healthcare SaaS companies serving providers or healthcare IT consulting experience with provider clients (Accenture, Deloitte, Guidehouse, Milliman, or similar firms)
Deep familiarity with EHR systems (Epic, Cerner, Athena) and health system IT architecture
Experience with voice AI, outbound patient engagement platforms, dialers, or telephony configuration
Knowledge of healthcare compliance and regulatory frameworks relevant to providers (HIPAA, CMS, state regulations, quality reporting)
Track record of scaling implementation processes across multiple health systems or provider networks
Understanding of clinical workflows and ability to translate clinical requirements into technical use case design

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.
We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future.
Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.
We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.
Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

jobs.title: Business analyst
jobs.description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Understand.
Build a 360° understanding of your product, users, business model, competitive landscape, and economics. Use AI, data, and research to uncover key business drivers, diagnose challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and product development.
Ideate.
Turn insights into concrete opportunities and hypotheses for testing. Explore new products features, growth initiatives, monetization opportunities, and improvements to how the business operates, prioritizing those with the greatest potential impact.
Execute.
Turn the most promising opportunities into action and clear customer value. Support roadmap conversations with enterprise clients, build the business case, and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and other teams to bring initiatives to life.
Optimize.
Use A/B tests, business and product metrics, and ongoing analysis to understand what works and what doesn’t. Scale successful initiatives, improve existing ones, and use each result to inform the next cycle of discovery and execution.

What we look for
Reasoning ability.
Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive.
You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit.
You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English.
You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.
You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth.
We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits.
Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.
Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract

Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location

Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process

In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply

If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

new_jobs.description:
About Northern Trust

Northern Trust, a Fortune 500 company, is a globally recognized, award-winning financial institution that has been in continuous operation since 1889.

Northern Trust is proud to provide innovative financial services and guidance to the world’s most successful individuals, families, and institutions by remaining true to our enduring principles of service, expertise, and integrity. With more than 130 years of financial experience and over 22,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

Role Description

Northern Trust seeks a Cybersecurity AI Delivery Lead
to drive execution of strategic cybersecurity projects and programs that enable secure adoption and operation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) including agentic AI systems and Large Language Models (LLMs.) The Delivery Lead ensures AI solutions are designed and implemented with appropriate identity controls for both human and non-human/agent identities, robust data protection and privacy controls for prompts and training data, and operational monitoring and response controls for AI-enabled services and workloads.

Major Duties

Program Delivery

Lead global, cross-functional teams consisting of security engineers, platform engineers, data/ML engineers, product owners, and consultants to drive successful execution of strategic cybersecurity and AI security projects and programs.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define expected benefits, risk-reduction outcomes, and measurable control objectives for AI-enabled capabilities; ensure successful achievement through project completion.
Plan and execute delivery of AI-related IAM controls (e.g., workload identities, managed identities/service principals, least privilege, approval workflows, secrets/key management) to govern access by AI services and autonomous agents.
Plan and execute delivery of AI-related data protection controls (e.g., data classification, DLP, encryption/key management, retention, masking/tokenization, prompt/response handling, embedding and vector store protections) aligned to enterprise privacy and regulatory requirements.
Plan and execute delivery of AI-related security operations controls (e.g., logging/telemetry for AI requests, abuse monitoring, anomaly detection, SIEM/SOAR integrations, incident response playbooks, red teaming, and continuous validation).
Identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies to ensure successful project completion. This includes AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, insecure output handling, and model theft.
Develop integrated project schedules including effort estimates and task sequencing; ensure projects are optimally coordinated across product teams, control owners, and platform teams for efficient delivery.
Lead resolution of conflicts and escalations in support of project or program delivery.
Create and submit weekly project/program status reports that are accurate, timely, and comply with team guidelines; provide clear, executive-ready risk and decision narratives.
Establish and maintain a project artifact repository; review deliverables to ensure quality and adherence to internal software delivery methodology as well as AI lifecycle governance.

Communication And Stakeholder Management

Develop project charters; develop and execute project communication plans.
Facilitate engagement with cross-impacted technology and business stakeholders.
Translate complex AI/LLM and agentic-system concepts (architecture, data flows, model behavior, controls) into clear, actionable plans and decisions for stakeholders.
Identify and execute approaches to resolve complex problems through critical thinking, structured analysis, and fact-based recommendations.

Change / Risk Management

Define and document project scope and ensure scope alignment to project objectives and goals.
Perform and follow project change control procedures for scope, resources, and financials where required.
Ensure adherence to technology Change Management requirements and procedures for system implementations and AI model/service releases.
Drive AI security and risk activities across the delivery lifecycle including AI threat modeling, control design reviews, testing/evaluation, and go-live readiness assessments.

Financial Management

Oversee Financial Management And Performance For Projects Including

developing and/or managing project-specific capital and expense budgets including all financial form submissions required by internal finance teams
preparing and submitting timely monthly forecasts (i.e., Clarity PPM)
proactively analyzing and managing monthly budget variance
optimizing spending on assigned projects
participation in annual budget planning

Staff Management

Identify project resource needs and work with leadership to ensure staffing requirements are met.
Manage project resources to deliver tasks, optimize resource utilization, and resolve conflicts.
Provide constructive performance feedback regarding staff performance to leadership and line managers.
Foster a supportive project delivery environment that encourages participation, teamwork, and collaboration.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience Required

A successful candidate for the role will have at least 10 years of overall experience including in the Financial Services industry, with at least 5 years’ experience leading and managing high-visibility technology projects that involve Artificial Intelligence. Additionally, the candidate will possess:

Strong executive presence and communication skills with experience leading high-visibility initiatives in a fast-paced program environment.
Cybersecurity Project Management Experience – leading and driving execution of cybersecurity projects related to Identity & Access Management (e.g., PAM, IGA, IAA), Data Protection, Security Operations, Attack Surface Management, or adjacent control domains.
AI Delivery & Security Experience including delivering AI/ML or GenAI capabilities (including LLM and agentic AI solutions) in regulated environments, with demonstrated expertise in securing AI services, data pipelines, and AI-enabled applications.
Agentic AI & LLM Technical Fluency, including working knowledge of LLM application patterns (e.g., tool/function calling, orchestration, vector/embedding stores), agent frameworks, and common failure modes (hallucinations, prompt injection, excessive agency).
AI-Related IAM Controls – experience designing/implementing identity and access controls for AI services and agents (e.g., workload identities, managed identities/service principals, OAuth/OIDC flows, RBAC/ABAC, privileged access workflows, secrets and API key management, approval, and just-in-time access).
AI-Related Data Protection Controls – experience implementing data governance and protection controls for training/grounding data and user prompts/responses (e.g., classification, DLP, encryption/CMK, tokenization/masking, retention, secure data sharing, access logging, and data residency considerations).
AI Security Operations Controls – experience operationalizing monitoring and response for AI services (e.g., audit and diagnostic logging, telemetry for model endpoints, abuse monitoring, anomaly detection, SOC runbooks, incident response for data leakage or model misuse).
Framework & Threat Modeling Knowledge – familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) and AI threat catalogs (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS) and ability to translate them into delivery requirements, controls, and measurable outcomes.
Organizational Savvy – experience working within a matrixed organization to drive delivery of complex projects involving multiple disciplines.
Critical Thinking Skills – ability to oversee ambiguous or complex issues including identifying creative resolution paths and gaining alignment and support from leadership and stakeholders to bring to resolution.
Superior Communication Skills – ability to translate complex work into digestible terms; able to articulate ideas and information verbally and in writing for varying audiences, including senior executives.
Initiative – evidence of taking initiative at suggesting improvements and anticipating the needs of leadership, program stakeholders, and team members.
Organizational Skills – able to manage multiple simultaneous work deliverables and prioritize them accordingly.
Delivery Mindset – has a delivery mindset with a bias for action, curiosity to learn, challenge, and enhance processes.
Expert Analytical Skills – able to assemble data, analyze patterns and trends, and draw conclusions and recommendations; rely on data to guide decisions.
Financial Management Experience – managing project budgets between $250K to $3M comprised of internal and external labor.
Knowledge of and experience working in software delivery lifecycle methodologies (e.g., Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, etc.) and AI lifecycle controls (e.g., model release governance, testing/validation evidence).
Experience in demand & capacity management.
Proficiency with: Project planning tools such as MS Project, Azure DevOps (or similar), Clarity PPM, Microsoft Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), MS Teams
A College or University degree; MBA or relevant advanced degree a plus.
Current PMP certification is strongly preferred but not required.
Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM) and/or AI/Cloud certifications (e.g., Azure, AWS) a plus.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Northern Trust will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

Northern Trust provides a comprehensive benefits package including retirement benefits (401k and pension), health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, spending accounts and disability), paid time off, parental and caregiver leave, life & accident insurance, and other voluntary and well-being benefits.
